Our analysis explains how model-internal signals steer sampling toward higher-density regions of the learned distribution to address low-density sampling risk. However, higher model likelihood does not guarantee physical plausibility, motivating external guidance to address high-density drifting risk. Based on this framework, we develop Hallucination-Aware Sampler (HA-Sampler), which applies external physical guidance within latent refinement to generate physically plausible videos, and HA-Scorer, which derives a likelihood-based signal from the generator itself for evaluating generated videos using continuous normalizing flow (CNF), with coarse ODE integration and finite-difference divergence estimates. Experiments on Physics-IQ and VideoPhy benchmarks support our theoretical analysis and demonstrate that our methods outperform the compared sampling and scoring SOTA baselines.

</details>


### [223] [Not All Similarity Is Leakage: Distribution-Aware Identity Leakage Assessment in Synthetic Face Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26077)
*Paweł Borsukiewicz,Daniele Lunghi,Wendkûuni C. Ouédraogo,Fadi Boutros,Jacques Klein,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出新的度量指标 Scaled Overlap (SO)，将非参数的数据复制检测扩展到人脸身份层面，并通过多分类器集成来更可靠地量化合成人脸数据中的身份泄露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据本应带来更符合伦理、偏见更少的人脸识别数据，但生成模型及其条件机制的局限会造成身份泄露，使合成样本过度相似于生成器训练集中的样本，从而削弱隐私收益。现有方法存在两大问题：高度依赖单一分类器，以及倾向于把泄露归因于未参与训练的真实数据集。

Method: 提出 Scaled Overlap (SO) 度量：改造现有的非参数数据复制检验（data-copying test），将其从样本层面扩展到身份层面；同时采用多模型（multi-model）设置，以补偿单个分类器的误差。

Result: 识别出存在泄露的数据集（CemiFace、SFace2、IDNet），其中 CemiFace 因生成模型条件机制导致的泄露最为严重；证明真实数据集对生成器训练的贡献并不均等；并表明多数合成图像来自多个身份而非单一身份。

Conclusion: 研究为合成人脸数据集的质量提供了新见解，并给出更可靠的技术手段，帮助社区保障合成数据的可信度。

Abstract: Synthetic data provides the means for more ethical and less biased facial recognition. Nonetheless, the limitations of generative models and the conditioning process they rely on pose a risk of identity leakage, resulting in synthetic samples that are overly similar to those seen in a generator's training set, mitigating privacy benefits. In this work, we show that previously proposed approaches are affected by two key limitations: high classifier dependence and a tendency to identify leakage with respect to real datasets that were not used in training. To address these shortcomings, we propose a novel metric called Scaled Overlap (SO), which adapts a non-parametric data-copying test for facial recognition and extends it to the identity level. By leveraging a multi-model setup that compensates for errors in individual classifiers, it provides insights into the true strength of identity leakage. Our analysis identifies leaking datasets (CemiFace, SFace2, IDNet) with the most acute leakage introduced by generative model conditioning in CemiFace, demonstrates that real datasets do not contribute equally to generator training, and shows that the majority of synthetic images are drawn from multiple identities rather than relying on a single identity. Ultimately, our study provides new insights into the quality of synthetic datasets and gives more reliable techniques to help the community ensure the trustworthiness of synthetic data.

</details>


### [224] [DCR-TSF: Dual-Level Compositional Reasoning with Triadic Spherical Fusion for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26078)
*Gwang-Ho Na,Ho-Joong Kim,Seong-Whan Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练框架 DCR-TSF，通过双层组合推理（DCR）与三元球面融合（TSF）解决现有零样本组合图像检索中外观偏置和原始查询信息被削弱的问题，在 CIRCO、CIRR、Fashion-IQ 上取得免训练方法的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练零样本组合图像检索（ZS-CIR）方法依赖细粒度生成的目标描述，往往过度强调参考图的特定视觉细节，导致检索结果偏向外观；同时这些描述由多模态大模型生成，使得原始图像-文本查询在最终检索表示中的直接影响被削弱。

Method: 提出 DCR-TSF：DCR（双层组合推理）从参考图与修改文本生成细粒度与粗粒度描述，捕获不同层次的互补目标侧语义；TSF（三元球面融合）先对参考图特征与修改文本特征做球面插值构造组合查询锚点，再用单位超球面上的加权 Karcher 均值将锚点与细、粗粒度表示融合。

Result: 在 CIRCO、CIRR、Fashion-IQ 三个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在免训练方法中达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 最终查询表示同时兼顾细节视觉证据、高层语义抽象以及原始组合查询的直接保留，验证了多粒度生成描述与球面融合结合的有效性。

Abstract: Zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that reflects an intended textual modification while maintaining semantic consistency with a reference image. Existing training-free ZS-CIR methods typically rely on fine-grained generated target descriptions, which often overemphasize reference-specific visual details and lead to appearance-biased retrieval. Moreover, since these descriptions are generated through multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the direct influence of the original image-text query can be weakened in the final retrieval representation. In this paper, we propose DCR-TSF, a training-free ZS-CIR framework that combines Dual-level Compositional Reasoning (DCR) and Triadic Spherical Fusion (TSF). DCR generates fine- and coarse-grained descriptions from the reference image and modification text, capturing complementary target-side semantics across different granularities. To preserve the original image-text query information, TSF constructs a composed-query anchor by spherically interpolating the reference image feature and modification text feature, and fuses it with the fine- and coarse-grained representations using a weighted Karcher mean on the unit hypersphere. The resulting final query representation balances detailed visual evidence, high-level semantic abstraction, and direct preservation of the original composed query. Extensive experiments on CIRCO, CIRR, and Fashion-IQ demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods.

</details>


### [225] [Toolkit for Facial Deidentification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26079)
*Esteban Leiva-Montenegro,Matthieu Pillot,Manfred Gonzalez-Hernandez,Vitomir Struc,Peter Peer,Blaž Meden*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个开源的人脸去标识化评估工具箱，集成预处理、去标识化与性能评估的完整流程，涵盖数据效用、图像质量与身份保护三类指标，并支持多数据集以标准化基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人脸去标识化技术缺乏统一的评估标准，新方法之间难以公平比较；作者希望以标准化评估框架统一未来研究。

Method: 构建开源工具包，提供从预处理、去标识化到性能评估的端到端流水线，内置评估模型，并基于数据效用、图像质量和身份保护指标进行度量，同时支持多种数据集。

Result: 实验表明部分技术在保持图像效用的同时能有效保护隐私。

Conclusion: 该工具包为面部生物特征隐私增强技术提供标准化评估框架，有助于统一和规范后续研究，代码已在 GitHub 开源。

Abstract: This work presents a novel open-source toolkit designed for the evaluation of face deidentification techniques with available evaluation models. The framework provides a complete evaluation pipeline, including preprocessing, deidentification, and performance assessment, based on data utility, image quality, and identity protection metrics. It supports a variety of datasets, enabling researchers to easily benchmark new deidentification techniques. Results show the effectiveness of some techniques on maintaining privacy while preserving image utility. The toolkit is aimed at unifying future research by providing a standard evaluation framework for privacy-enhancing technologies in facial biometrics. Implementation is available at github.com/blazm/deid-toolkit.

</details>


### [226] [DeOverlay: A Benchmark and Source-Anchored Flow for Video Overlay Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26081)
*Deshui Miao,Yuhang Ma,Shaoyong Jia,Wenzhao Gao,Yue Zhang,Shaohui Jiao,Xin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出源锚定的流模型 DeOverlay，以固定的源潜变量引导重建被字幕/标题/logo遮挡的场景，并发布 DVTE-Bench 基准；在全部五项指标上优于四个基线，Mask LPIPS 与 Mask VFID 分别降低 58.3% 和 70.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频覆盖物去除方法依赖时序传播或源条件生成，当有用源信息被遮挡时会残留覆盖物并扭曲场景结构；同时缺少覆盖类型多样、标注规范的统一评测基准。

Method: DeOverlay：以源潜变量为锚点的流模型，共享速度网络沿成对的"源—干净"路径训练，采用区域加权流匹配，可从中间状态逐步校正；局部源线索通过可见性归一化的时序聚合获取（剔除被掩码位置并对剩余观测取平均），全局源上下文与编辑区域嵌入以加性条件注入，保持单一视频 token 序列。另构建 DVTE-Bench（1,631 对视频、八类文字覆盖，含 OCR 筛选的干净目标、帧对齐像素掩码与统一评测协议）。

Result: 在完整发布版上，DeOverlay 在全部五项重建与感知指标上超过四个基线，相对最强基线 Mask LPIPS 降低 58.3%、Mask VFID 降低 70.3%；定性结果还显示可去除图形 logo 与贴纸。

Conclusion: 以源锚定流匹配替代传统传播/条件生成，能更稳健地恢复被遮挡场景结构；配套的 DVTE-Bench 提供了跨覆盖类型的统一评测，作者将公开基准、评测代码与测试输出。

Abstract: Video overlay removal aims to recover scenes obscured by subtitles, titles, and logos while preserving surrounding content. Existing methods use temporal propagation or source-conditioned generation, but can leave residual overlays and distort scene structure when useful source information is obscured. We propose DeOverlay, a source-anchored flow model that reconstructs the clean video from the source latent with fixed source guidance. Specifically, we train a shared velocity network along paired source-to-clean paths using region-weighted flow matching, enabling successive cor- rections from intermediate states. To select local source cues, we develop visibility-normalized temporal aggregation that excludes masked positions and averages the remaining observations. Global source context and edit-region embeddings complement these cues through additive condi- tioning, retaining a single video-token sequence. To evaluate scene recovery across diverse overlay conditions, we introduce DVTE-Bench, comprising 1,631 paired videos across eight text-overlay categories, with OCR-screened clean targets, frame-aligned pixel masks, and a common evaluation protocol. Experiments on the complete release show that DeOverlay outperforms four baselines on all five reconstruction and perceptual metrics, reducing Mask LPIPS and Mask VFID by 58.3% and 70.3%, respectively, relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. Additional qualitative examples demonstrate the removal of graphic logos and stickers. We will make the complete benchmark, evaluation code, and test outputs availabl. Project page:https://yahooo-m.github.io/DVTE-Bench/

</details>


### [227] [Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network for Asymmetric EEG-Eye Movement Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26084)
*Peijun Shi,Xiujin Zhu,Zhenguo Lao,Chee-Onn Chow,Wei Ru Wong,Zhen Liu,Xiaobing Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CTD-GNet：以EEG电极构建图节点、以眼动与历史窗口调制图边/节点/读出，并用双向蒸馏耦合多模态教师与单窗EEG学生，在SEED/SEED-IV上取得最高平均准确率与最强鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG-眼动情绪识别融合模型多把两模态当作并行特征、逐窗口独立分类，一旦眼动数据缺失性能明显下降，缺乏跨模态结构建模与对缺失模态的鲁棒性。

Method: 构建电极图：EEG特征为节点，眼动与前一窗口信息通过电极专属提示（prompt）调制图的边、节点与读出；同时对图结构、节点关系与预测做双向蒸馏，将多模态教师与单窗口EEG学生耦合训练，使教师自身得到改进并实现两图对齐（对齐规模提升35倍）。

Result: 留一被试交叉验证下，SEED/SEED-IV平均准确率84.91%/76.17%，为17个基线中最高；Holm校正后在13个基于眼动的基线中分别显著优于9个和6个；多模态模型中跨被试方差最小、最差被试准确率最高。SEED-IV各眼动缺失率下均最准确，SEED无眼动时保持66.1%（优于所有EEG单模态模型），一标准差眼动噪声下高出所有单窗融合模型9.3与11.9个点；未见影片片段上SEED达77.1%。

Conclusion: 以图为载体的跨模态调制加双向蒸馏，可在提升融合精度的同时显著增强对眼动缺失与噪声的鲁棒性，并具备跨被试与跨刺激泛化优势。

Abstract: EEG-eye movement emotion recognition can support mental-health monitoring and adaptive interfaces, but most fusion models treat the two signals as parallel features, classify each window alone and degrade when eye data are lost. We propose the Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network (CTD-GNet), in which EEG features form the nodes of an electrode graph, and eye movements and preceding windows modulate its edges, nodes and readout, the edges through electrode-specific prompts. Bidirectional distillation of the graph, node relations and predictions couples this multimodal teacher with a single-window EEG student, improving the teacher and aligning the two graphs 35-fold. In leave-one-subject-out tests on SEED and SEED-IV against 17 baselines, CTD-GNet has the highest mean accuracy, 84.91% and 76.17%, significantly above 9 and 6 of 13 eye-based baselines after Holm correction, the smallest cross-subject spread among multimodal models and the highest worst-subject accuracy. It is the most accurate model at every rate of missing eye data on SEED-IV, keeps 66.1% on SEED without eye data, more than any EEG-only model, and stays 9.3 and 11.9 points above all single-window fusion models under eye-movement noise of one standard deviation. On film clips unseen in training, it leads on SEED with 77.1%.

</details>


### [228] [RGB--Event Object Detection Across Operating Frequencies via Reliability-Supervised Routing and Asymmetric-Resolution Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26090)
*Peijun Shi,Jiannan Zhao,Xiujin Zhu,Zhenguo Lao,Chee-Onn Chow,Wei Ru Wong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ERA-Det：用可靠性监督的空间路由分配逐位置融合权重，并以非对称分辨率融合让RGB帧承载高分辨率信息，在DSEC-Det上以63.2 mAP刷新SOTA，并使20→180 Hz的精度损失由6.3降至3.1 mAP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶要求检测速度快于相机帧率，事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率，可在帧间做决策。但运行频率越高，每个决策可用的事件窗口越稀疏，事件相对帧的可靠性随场景与时间变化。现有检测器只在样本级别对传感器加权，并把RGB帧降采样到事件分辨率编码，无法应对逐位置、逐时刻变化的可靠性差异。

Method: 两点核心设计：1）可靠性监督路由（reliability-supervised routing）：为每个空间位置分配融合权重，训练时仅用两个单模态分类器的损失生成监督目标，把基于损失的融合权重监督从整样本粒度下移到逐位置粒度；2）非对称分辨率融合（asymmetric-resolution fusion）：帧以原生分辨率编码，并将各层级特征池化到事件网格上对齐融合，从而完全复用预训练权重，在事件失效处由帧承担决策。

Result: 在DSEC-Det上，路由将20→180 Hz的精度下降从6.3 mAP减半至3.1 mAP，且在全部随机种子下均有效；ERA-Det达到63.2 mAP，较FlexEvent高3.7 mAP，在所有运行频率上领先，180 Hz时精度高于FlexEvent在20 Hz的水平。在两个DAVIS346数据集上，路由在夜间与低照度下降低帧权重，在事件消失时提高帧权重。仅用单张GPU、5,000次迭代即可升级已发布的FlexEvent权重。

Conclusion: 将融合可靠性建模从样本级细化到位置级并结合非对称分辨率融合，可显著提升RGB-事件检测器在高运行频率下的鲁棒性与精度，且具备低成本迁移到已有权重的能力。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles must detect objects faster than a frame camera delivers images. Event cameras record brightness changes with microsecond resolution, so RGB--event detectors can decide between frames, at an operating frequency, the rate of decisions, far above the frame rate. As this rate rises, each decision receives a sparser event window, and the reliability of the events relative to the frame varies over the scene and over time. Existing detectors weight the sensors per sample and encode the frame at the reduced event resolution. Reliability-supervised routing assigns a fusion weight to every location and supervises it with targets from the losses of two single-modality classifiers used only in training, moving loss-based supervision of fusion weights from whole samples to individual locations. Asymmetric-resolution fusion lets the frame carry the decision where the events fail: it encodes the frame at native resolution and pools every feature level onto the event grid, reusing all pretrained weights. On the DSEC-Det dataset, routing halves the accuracy loss from 20 to 180 Hz, from 6.3 to 3.1 mAP, and lowers it in every seed. The resulting detector, ERA-Det, sets a new state of the art at 63.2 mAP, 3.7 mAP above FlexEvent, leads at every operating frequency, and at 180 Hz is more accurate than FlexEvent at 20 Hz. On two DAVIS346 datasets, the router lowers the frame weight at night and in low light and raises it when the events vanish. ERA-Det upgrades released FlexEvent weights in 5,000 iterations on one GPU.

</details>


### [229] [GeoNaviDiff: Transferring Disentangled Semantic Controls to Diffusion Features via Local Riemannian Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26091)
*Tao Sun,Huanting Guo,Baao Xie,Zhou Fang,Qiuyu Chen,Hao Zheng,Wenjun Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GeoNaviDiff，将 StyleSpace 的解耦干预迁移为扩散模型 h-空间的局部黎曼轨迹，实现无监督、无需编辑参考的真实图像解耦操控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: StyleSpace 具备可解释、因子级的语义控制能力，但受限于 GAN 反演的重建质量；扩散模型图像生成保真度更高，却缺乏显式的因子化解耦控制基。二者优势互补存在空白。

Method: 无监督跨空间框架：先用匹配的 StyleGAN 重建-编辑对提取球面 Log-map 切向量，并平行移动至真实图像的扩散状态，构造与重建解耦的监督信号；共享的因子条件 Navigator 在推理时预测该切向量；配合保范测地线实现与源锚定 rollout 稳定反向扩散过程，无需编辑参考或因子专用模型。

Result: 在多数据集实验中，GeoNaviDiff 在保真度、因子选择性、编辑局部性与轨迹平滑度上均优于对比方法。

Conclusion: 通过几何切向迁移可将 GAN 的解耦语义控制嫁接到扩散模型，为真实图像解耦编辑提供无需参考、单一模型通用的可行路径。

Abstract: Disentangled real-image manipulation requires factor-specific semantic control while preserving image fidelity and non-target content. StyleSpace $S$ provides interpretable controls but is limited by GAN inversion, whereas diffusion models offer stronger image realization without an explicit factorized control basis. We introduce GeoNaviDiff, an unsupervised cross-space framework that transfers disentangled StyleSpace interventions to local Riemannian trajectories in diffusion $h$-space. GeoNaviDiff constructs reconstruction-decoupled supervision by extracting a spherical Log-map tangent from a matched StyleGAN reconstruction-edit pair and parallel-transporting it to the real-image diffusion state. A shared, factor-conditioned Navigator predicts this tangent at inference, while norm-preserving geodesic realization and source-anchored rollout stabilize the reverse process without edited references or factor-specific models. Experiments across multiple datasets show that GeoNaviDiff outperforms the compared methods in fidelity, factor selectivity, edit locality, and trajectory smoothness.

</details>


### [230] [How Robust Are Prognostic Radiomic Features? Comparing Selection Techniques on Pooled Glioblastoma Cohorts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26095)
*Yannick Sodonougbo,Marlene Schnieders,Alexia Rizoudis,Santiago Cepeda,Frank Kramer,Dominik Müller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究在705例IDH野生型胶质母细胞瘤患者中比较了三种特征筛选方法（中位分割log-rank检验、单因素Cox回归、SHAP解释的XGBoost），发现不同方法选出的预后特征差异显著，说明分析方法本身会实质性影响"预后影像组学特征"的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胶质母细胞瘤影像组学生存研究报道的预后特征高度异质，但很少考察这种异质性在多大程度上源于分析方法本身的选择。

Method: 纳入三个公开队列共705例IDH野生型胶质母细胞瘤患者的治疗前MRI，提取463个影像组学、解剖及临床特征。采用三种技术评估其与总生存的关联：中位分割后的log-rank检验、单因素Cox回归（二者均做Benjamini-Hochberg校正）、以及用SHAP解释的XGBoost回归模型；并分析特征重叠情况与效应方向一致性。

Result: log-rank检验选出99个特征，Cox回归选出72个，SHAP给出前20个；三种方法共同选出的仅5个：年龄、一个瘤周T2纹理特征、瘤周掩膜连通分量数，以及两个图像级强度极大值。两种生存检验共享51个特征；SHAP前20中约半数也被任一检验选中；重叠处效应方向一致。许多被选特征为不限肿瘤体素的PyRadiomics诊断类描述符。

Conclusion: 分析流程的选择（包括排序方法、预过滤和描述符处理方式）会显著影响哪些特征表现为"预后相关"，影像组学生存研究的特征可重复性问题部分源自方法学差异，需在报告与验证中予以明确。

Abstract: Radiomic survival studies in glioblastoma report heterogeneous prognostic features, but how much of this stems from the methodology itself is rarely examined. We analysed the association of 463 radiomic, anatomical and clinical features from pre-treatment MRI with overall survival in 705 IDH-wildtype glioblastoma patients from three public cohorts, using three techniques: a log-rank test after median split, univariate Cox regression (both Benjamini-Hochberg corrected) and an XGBoost regressor interpreted with SHAP. The log-rank test selected 99 features, Cox regression 72 and SHAP its top 20; five were selected by all three: age, a peritumoural T2 texture feature, the number of connected peritumoural mask components and two image-level intensity maxima. The two survival tests shared 51 features, about half of the SHAP top 20 were also selected by either test, and where selections overlapped, effect directions agreed. Many selections were PyRadiomics diagnostic descriptors that are not restricted to tumour voxels. Analytical pipeline choices, including ranking method, pre-filtering and descriptor handling, can substantially influence which features appear prognostic.

</details>


### [231] [PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for 6D Object Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26096)
*Emirkan Burak Yilmaz,Yakup Genc*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PnP-Transformer：一个无迭代、可微的 6D 位姿求解器，替代经典 PnP-RANSAC；在七个 BOP 数据集上达到 41.2% 平均 AR，但同管线换成 EPnP-RANSAC 后可达 52.2% AR（每物体多 60 ms），揭示精度-时延权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 PnP-RANSAC 求解器需要迭代与随机采样，不可微、难以嵌入端到端管线且时延较高；作者希望用无需迭代、可微的神经网络位姿求解器替代它，以提升效率并支持与对应模块的分开训练集成。

Method: PnP-Transformer 以预测出的半稠密 2D-3D 对应场及其置信度分数为输入，将几何输入映射到连续潜空间后直接回归 6D 物体位姿，不使用 RANSAC 迭代。将其集成进零样本 6D 位姿估计管线，对应模块与位姿求解器分别独立训练。

Result: 在七个核心 BOP 基准数据集上取得 41.2% 平均 AR，单物体时延仅 0.46 s，优于除 Co-op（58.4% AR）之外的所有先前基线（如 RayPose 39.1% AR）。保持对应模块不变、将求解器替换为 EPnP-RANSAC 后，RANSAC 方案在七个数据集中的六个上优于 PnP-Transformer，平均 AR 达 52.2%，代价是每物体额外约 60 ms。

Conclusion: PnP-Transformer 作为轻量的可微位姿求解器在速度上具有优势，但尚未在精度上超越经典 RANSAC 求解器；作者更倾向于将其定位为提供精度-时延权衡的替代方案，代码与预训练模型已开源。

Abstract: We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer

</details>


### [232] [TriTD: Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution Distillation for Real-Time Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26165)
*Jia Li,Xurui Peng,Haowei Zhu,Tianyu Zhao,Jiexi Wang,Youwei Zheng,Yuxi Ren,Xinglong Wu,Xing Wang,Hayden Kwok-Hay So*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出TriTD框架，通过轨迹蒸馏、分块梯度加噪与正交并行DMD三个模块协同优化，在单张H100上实现26.8 FPS的实时流式视频生成，同时保持更优视觉质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散是高效视频生成的主流范式，但生成质量与推理效率之间存在权衡瓶颈。作者将该瓶颈归因于三类误差来源：基础模型误差、训练-推理分布失配、以及上游误差传播，并希望以此为基础实现质量与效率的联合优化。

Method: 先推导每步误差与累积误差的闭式上界作为理论依据；然后提出三分式轨迹-分布协同蒸馏框架TriTD，包含：(1) 面向ODE初始化的Next-Node Trajectory Distillation（NTD），缩短监督视野以降低回归误差下限；(2) Chunk-Graded Noising（CGN），采用单调非减的分块加噪调度，缩小训练-推理噪声失配并消除冗余KV-cache更新；(3) Orthogonal-Parallel DMD（OP-DMD），在保留原始DMD监督的同时于正交子空间加入回归约束，抑制离轴漂移。

Result: 大量实验表明，TriTD在视觉质量上持续优于现有基线，并在单张H100 GPU上达到26.8 FPS的实时吞吐。

Conclusion: TriTD为交互式流式视频生成提供了一种质量与效率均衡的解决方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion has emerged as a leading paradigm for efficient video generation, yet its practical deployment remains bottlenecked by the trade-off between generation quality and inference efficiency. We attribute this bottleneck to three error sources in AR rollouts: the base model error, the train-inference distribution mismatch, and the upstream error propagation. Building on this decomposition, we derive closed-form upper bounds on the per-step and cumulative errors, providing a principled basis for jointly optimizing generation quality and inference efficiency. Guided by this analysis, we propose TriTD, a Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution co-optimized distillation framework with three complementary modules. First, for ODE initialization, we adopt a Next-Node Trajectory Distillation (NTD) objective, which shortens the supervision horizon and admits a lower regression-error floor. Second, we introduce Chunk-Graded Noising (CGN), a monotonically non-decreasing per-chunk noising schedule that helps narrow the expected train-inference noise mismatch and removes redundant KV-cache updates, yielding substantial speedups at no quality cost. Third, we propose Orthogonal-Parallel DMD (OP-DMD), a distribution-matching loss that retains the original DMD supervision while introducing an additional regression constraint in the orthogonal subspace to suppress off-axis drift, improving both training stability and final generation quality. Extensive experiments show that TriTD consistently surpasses existing baselines in visual quality while reaching a real-time throughput of 26.8 FPS on a single H100 GPU, delivering a balanced quality-efficiency solution for interactive streaming video generation.

</details>


### [233] [Learning Goal-Conditioned Subgoals through Frozen Hierarchical World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26179)
*Xiang Kaibo,Liu Qingfeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用轻量级目标条件网络替代分层世界模型（HWM）中昂贵的上层候选轨迹搜索，通过冻结的高层预测器生成潜空间路径点，在保持自回归高层规划的同时显著降低推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层世界模型依靠一个粗粒度高层模型向低层控制器传递预测状态来实现长视野规划，但选取这些状态（宏动作）代价高昂：上层规划器需要对候选宏动作轨迹反复求导。作者希望以低开销方式获得同样的规划能力。

Method: 训练一个轻量级目标条件网络，经由冻结的高层预测器进行端到端训练。网络输出条件向量，由冻结预测器生成下一个潜空间路径点。训练仅使用离线轨迹上的事后目标（hindsight goals）与状态预测损失，不需要搜索解作为监督目标，也不需要宏动作标签。推理阶段仍保留高层自回归展开，但无需任何高层候选优化。实验基于 H-JEPA 提供的共享潜空间 HWM 检查点，每骨干使用 3 个随机种子、3 种头部初始化，并采用统一评测协议。

Result: 平均成功率：Cube 70.4%、Push-T 48.7%、FourRoom 100.0%、Visual AntMaze 71.1%。相比对应的 HWM 搜索基线，在三个环境中取得提升，在 Push-T 上持平。在 NVIDIA L40S 上，批量评测的端到端加速为 1.28–4.39 倍。消融显示状态自适应条件向量是稳定的增益来源，而预测器介导的子目标与无约束条件带来的收益依赖于具体环境。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，无需候选搜索即可训练高层潜空间路径点生成器，在多数环境上匹配或超越搜索基线，并带来明显的推理加速；各组件的重要性存在环境依赖性，说明设计选择需结合任务特性。

Abstract: Hierarchical world models plan over long horizons by passing predicted states from a coarse model to a lower-level controller. Choosing these states can be expensive: the upper-level planner repeatedly differentiates through candidate macro-action trajectories. We replace this search with a lightweight goal-conditioned network trained through the frozen high-level predictor. The network supplies a conditioning vector, while the predictor generates the next latent waypoint. Training uses hindsight goals and state-prediction losses on offline trajectories, without search-solution targets or macro-action labels. Inference retains an autoregressive high-level rollout, but requires no high-level candidate optimization. We evaluate this approach on the shared-latent HWM checkpoints distributed with H-JEPA, using three backbone seeds and three head initializations per backbone. With a common evaluation protocol, mean success is 70.4% on Cube, 48.7% on Push-T, 100.0% on FourRoom, and 71.1% on Visual AntMaze. The method improves over the corresponding HWM search baseline on three environments and has the same mean on Push-T. Dedicated measurements on an NVIDIA L40S give 1.28-4.39x end-to-end speedups for batched evaluation. Ablations identify state-adaptive conditioning as a consistent contributor, while predictor-mediated subgoals and unrestricted conditions have environment-dependent benefits.

</details>


### [234] [HP-PnP-Flow: Hybrid Time Scheduling and Projection for Plug-and-Play Image Restoration via Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26183)
*Yong Li,Xiaojie Wang,Xiaoyan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出高效 PnP-Flow 算法 HP-PnP-Flow，通过改进时间调度并引入像素空间投影算子，在温和假设下获得严格收敛保证，且无需原 PnP-Flow 方法的限制性迭代条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PnP 框架便于把预训练去噪器嵌入迭代重建，flow matching 则提供高效的连续时间 ODE 生成建模；近期 Martin 等（ICLR 2025）将二者结合为 PnP-Flow，但该方法对迭代点施加了较严格的限制条件，且收敛性保证受限，迭代次数较多，效率有待提升。

Method: 在 PnP-Flow 基础上采用不同的时间调度（time schedule），并额外引入像素空间投影算子（pixel-space projection operator），构建新的高效 PnP-Flow 算法；理论分析在温和假设下给出严格收敛性保证，且不依赖原工作所需的迭代点限制条件。

Result: 在 CelebA 与 AFHQ-Cat 上的实验表明，HP-PnP-Flow 在去噪、去模糊、超分辨率、随机修复和块修复等任务上显著优于 PnP-Flow；在 AFHQ-Cat 的去模糊与超分辨率任务中，迭代次数由 500 降至 100，仍取得相当或更优的重建质量。

Conclusion: 改进的时间调度与像素空间投影使 PnP-Flow 在保持甚至提升重建质量的同时大幅降低迭代开销，并获得更强的收敛理论保证，说明该改进是有效且实用的。

Abstract: Image restoration is a fundamental inverse problem that seeks to recover high-quality images from degraded observations. Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods provide a flexible framework for integrating pretrained denoisers into iterative reconstruction, whereas flow matching offers an efficient generative modeling approach based on continuous-time ODE dynamics. Very recently, Martin et al.\ (ICLR, 2025) developed a PnP-Flow method, which integrates the PnP framework with flow matching through a time-dependent denoiser constructed from a pretrained flow matching model.By incorporating a different time schedule and an additional pixel-space projection operator, this paper proposes a novel efficient PnP-Flow algorithm (HP-PnP-Flow) that enjoys rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, without imposing restrictive conditions on iterates required by the aforementioned work. Numerical experiments on CelebA and AFHQ-Cat demonstrate that the newly proposed HP-PnP-Flow algorithm significantly outperforms PnP-Flow on several restoration tasks such as denoising, deblurring, super-resolution, random inpainting, and box inpainting. Notably, our algorithm achieves comparable or better reconstruction quality with substantially fewer iterations, reducing the iteration count from $500$ to $100$ for deblurring and super-resolution on AFHQ-Cat.

</details>


### [235] [Wan-Alpha++: Animating a Single RGBA Asset into Controllable Transparent Video Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26189)
*Haotian Dong,Xin Wang,Wenjing Wang,Chen Li,Jing Lyu,Yan Tina Luximon,Ping Li,Wanchao Su,Ke Xu,Di Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Wan-Alpha++ 是一个统一的 RGBA 视频生成框架，将可控 RGBA 生成能力从文本条件扩展到文本+图像条件，通过共享 RGBA 潜空间、透明度感知双向扩散目标、透明度引导均值采样器和时间相位重参数化，解决 RGB 与 alpha 分布纠缠及图像条件中的出现-消失问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGBA 视频生成对影视、游戏的可合成视觉素材很重要。现有文本到 RGBA 方法存在三个问题：(1) RGB 与 alpha 分布纠缠，难以精确控制目标外观；(2) 图像条件常出现"出现-消失"效应；(3) 首帧或首尾帧条件因边界帧全透明而失效。

Method: 提出统一框架 Wan-Alpha++，将会议版 Wan-Alpha 从文本条件扩展到使用内部参考帧的图像条件生成，共享同一 RGBA 潜空间。具体包含：(1) 在保留预训练 RGB 先验的前提下学习可平移的 RGB-alpha 分布；(2) 透明度感知的双向扩散目标，产生可区分的 RGBA 潜表示；(3) 透明度引导的均值采样器，平移噪声分布以改善透明度生成并提供空间可控性；(4) 用于图像条件效果生成的时间相位重参数化，将零-正-零 alpha 模式循环变换为正-零-正模式，把可见内容移到时间边界。

Result: 通过时间相位重参数化，在有限 RGBA 数据条件下实现了有效的图像条件外观控制，并把可见内容重定位到时间边界以规避全透明边界帧导致的条件失效问题。

Conclusion: Wan-Alpha++ 以共享 RGBA 潜空间统一文本与图像条件的 RGBA 视频生成，在保留 RGB 先验的同时改善透明度生成与空间可控性，并为图像条件效果生成提供可行方案。

Abstract: RGBA video generation is essential for creating compositable visual assets in filmmaking, game development, and digital content production. However, generating high-quality RGB appearance alongside temporally coherent transparency remains a significant challenge. Existing text-to-RGBA video methods often entangle RGB and alpha distributions and offer limited control over the precise appearance of a target asset. In addition, incorporating image conditioning typically suffers from the emergence-disappearance effects, which fail existing first-frame or first-and-last-frame conditions due to their fully transparent boundary frames. To address these issues, we present Wan-Alpha++, a unified framework that brings controllable RGBA video generation to both text- and image-to-video diffusion backbones through a shared RGBA latent space, extending our conference version Wan-Alpha from the text-conditioned setting to image-conditioned generation with an interior reference frame. Our method first learns shiftable RGB-alpha distributions while preserving the pretrained RGB prior. Specifically, we introduce a transparency-aware bidirectional diffusion objective to produce distinguishable RGBA latent representations, and a transparency-guided mean sampler that shifts the noise distribution to improve transparency generation and enable spatial controllability. Building upon this RGBA generation prior, we introduce temporal phase reparameterization for image-conditioned effect generation. By cyclically transforming a zero-positive-zero alpha pattern into a positive-zero-positive pattern, it relocates visible content to both temporal boundaries, facilitating effective appearance conditioning with limited RGBA data.

</details>


### [236] [GeoEdit: Adversarial De-Evidencing for Silent Geoprivacy Protection via Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26194)
*Yu Yan,Shengjia Cheng,Fei Ma,Zhe Wang,Peng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoEdit 是一个通过图像编辑实现"无声"地理隐私保护的对抗性去证据框架：仅对高风险地理证据锚点做最小编辑，破坏多模态大推理模型（MLRM）的隐式地理推理链，同时保持场景语义与图像保真度。在 LifePhotoBench 上对 6 个主流 MLRM 实现强保护，图像保真度较视觉扰动基线高出 0.59 以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大推理模型能联合分析细微视觉线索推断照片拍摄地点，使非专业攻击者也能实施人肉定位（doxing）。现有防御方法难以兼顾照片的可分享性与有效保护，且往往无法充分破坏嵌入场景语义中的隐式地理证据链。

Method: 提出 GeoEdit 对抗性去证据框架：1）定位图像中的高风险"证据锚点"，结合结构化知识与对抗性发现的地理线索；2）对这些锚点施加最小编辑，以打断底层空间推理链而保留整体场景语义；3）采用可学习策略在庞大编辑动作空间中迭代优化编辑决策，并将成功编辑轨迹蒸馏为可迁移的自然语言经验，实现一致且高效的编辑。

Result: 在 LifePhotoBench 上评估，GeoEdit 对 6 个主流 MLRM 均取得强保护效果，图像保真度相比视觉扰动基线提升超过 0.59。

Conclusion: 通过"语义级去证据"而非单纯像素扰动，GeoEdit 在保护地理隐私的同时更好保持了照片的可分享性，为图像地理隐私保护提供了新思路。

Abstract: Recent efforts have demonstrated the strong capabilities of Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) in geographic reasoning. By jointly analyzing subtle visual cues, these models can infer the locations of photos, thus enabling doxing even by non-expert adversaries. Existing defense methods struggle to balance the shareability of photos with effective protection, and often fail to sufficiently disrupt the implicit geo-evidence chains embedded in scene semantics. To this end, we propose GeoEdit, an adversarial de-evidencing framework for silent geoprivacy protection via image editing. Specifically, we apply minimal edits to high-risk evidence anchors in the image, thereby disrupting the underlying spatial reasoning chains while preserving overall scene semantics. We identify these anchors by combining structured knowledge with adversarially discovered geographic cues. To further navigate the large editing action space, we adopt a learnable policy to iteratively refine editing decisions, distilling successful trajectories into transferable natural-language insights for consistent and efficient editing. Evaluated on LifePhotoBench, GeoEdit achieves strong protection against 6 mainstream MLRMs, outperforming visual perturbation baselines by over 0.59 in image fidelity.

</details>


### [237] [Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26203)
*Fuyao Zhang,Wenwen He,Jiaming Zhang,Yurong Hao,Xuan Wang,Guowei Guan,Che Wang,Longtao Huang,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Focused Perception 概念与 FocusGUI 适配器，通过按步骤动态聚焦多模态证据，解决 GUI agent 在流式全模态观察下的“顺序分心”问题，平均大幅提升动作匹配指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI agent 需要在截图、音频、视频、交互历史与设备状态等流式全模态观察上行动，但每步都均匀暴露全部上下文并不合理：相关性是短暂且稀疏的，决定某一步动作的信号到下一步可能就变成噪声；且已执行动作会反馈进上下文，使误差逐级累积，形成 Sequential Distraction，导致轨迹不可逆漂移。因此需要“聚焦感知”：表示应具备步骤自适应、动作充分且非侵入三项性质。

Method: 提出 FocusGUI，一种轻量适配器：以当前步骤特定的决策参考为依据，动态地对多模态通道做优先级排序，而非均匀处理所有输入；将最相关的证据压缩为紧凑潜表示，并以subtle 方式注入冻结解码器的 embedding 中，在不改变原生参数空间的前提下引导注意力。训练仅依赖动作监督，既不需要模态相关性标签，也不需要微调 backbone。

Result: 在四个全模态 backbone 上，相比冻结 backbone 平均提升 Type Match +33.2、Exact Match 提升至 3.0 倍；相比最强现有增强方法，Type Match 再提升 +30.1。

Conclusion: 按步骤聚焦稀疏相关的多模态证据是提升 GUI agent 动作准确性的关键，且可通过轻量、非侵入、仅用动作监督的适配方式实现，无需微调大模型本体。

Abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents increasingly act over streaming omni-modal observations spanning screenshots, audio, video, interaction history, and device states. However, exposing this complete context uniformly at every step ignores that relevance is transient and sparse: the signal determining one action can become clutter at the next. Because executed actions feed back into the context, these errors compound into Sequential Distraction, driving the agent into irreversible trajectory drift. We formulate the underlying requirement as Focused Perception: a representation that is step-adaptive, action-sufficient, and non-intrusive. We realize this in FocusGUI, a lightweight adapter that dynamically prioritizes multimodal channels against a step-specific decision reference. Instead of uniformly processing all inputs, it compresses the most relevant evidence into a compact latent and subtly injects it into the frozen decoder's embeddings, guiding the model's attention without altering its native parameter space. FocusGUI trains from action supervision alone, requiring neither modality-relevance labels nor backbone fine-tuning. Across four omni-modal backbones, it raises overall Type Match by +33.2 and Exact Match by 3.0 times over the frozen backbone on average, and Type Match by +30.1 over the strongest existing enhancement method.

</details>


### [238] [ExMR: Extremity Motion Refinement for Monocular Human Motion Capture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26213)
*Tom Wehrbein,Bodo Rosenhahn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ExMR系统，通过足部精化模块FootMR与手部精化模块HandMR，从单目视频重建3D全身、手与脚的动作，在手、脚重建上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手部与足部的精细关节运动对动画与运动分析很重要，但单目视频下难以恢复。现有表现力强的视频方法依赖共享的全身表示来推断手部关节，未充分利用局部证据。

Method: 先前会议工作提出FootMR，利用足部关键点精化脚踝旋转（即使初始估计器已使用相同关键点也能提升）。本文将此思想扩展到手部，提出HandMR：由于2D手指关键点常缺失或不可靠，HandMR结合预训练手部重建模型的图像特征与初始手臂/手部旋转，精化肘、腕、手指。二者集成为ExMR系统：先用时序估计器预测全身运动，再由两个精化器重新审视局部证据以预测残差关节旋转。

Result: 在ARCTIC、MOYO、RICH、MOOF数据集上，手部与足部重建优于SOTA；相较最强对比方法，在MOYO上手部逐顶点误差降低19%，脚踝关节角误差降低18%。

Conclusion: 显式引入局部证据精化（关键点与图像特征）可有效提升肢体末端重建精度，验证了从FootMR到HandMR的推广思路；代码与研究页面将公开。

Abstract: Detailed hand and foot articulation is important for animation and motion analysis, yet remains challenging to recover from monocular video. Recent expressive video methods infer hand articulation from shared whole-body representations. Our conference work suggests that this underexploits local evidence: the Foot Motion Refinement (FootMR) module refines ankle rotations from foot keypoints, improving reconstruction even when the initial estimator receives the same keypoints. We extend this principle to hands with the Hand Motion Refinement (HandMR) module. Because 2D finger keypoints are often missing or unreliable, HandMR combines image features of a pretrained hand reconstruction model with initial arm and hand rotations to refine elbows, wrists, and fingers. We integrate FootMR and HandMR into ExMR (Extremity Motion Refinement), a system for reconstructing 3D body, hand, and foot motion from monocular video. An initial temporal estimator predicts whole-body motion, after which both refiners revisit local evidence to predict residual joint rotations. Experiments on ARCTIC, MOYO, RICH, and MOOF show that ExMR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in hand and foot reconstruction, reducing hand per-vertex error and ankle joint angle error on MOYO by 19% and 18%, respectively, relative to the strongest competitor. Code will be made available for research purposes. Project page: https://twehrbein.github.io/exmr-website/

</details>


### [239] [RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26216)
*Yang Yue,Fangyun Wei,Yitong Wang,Jinjing Zhao,Henry Zheng,Dong Chen,Gao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"鲁棒预测"原则（生成相关信息应从被损坏的潜变量中可恢复），并据此设计 RoAR-VAE：RobustAlign 从损坏潜变量预测预训练语义特征，RobustRecon 重建干净图像，兼顾重建保真度与扩散可学习性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉分词器需同时保证图像保真度与潜变量对下游扩散模型的"可扩散性"（diffusability）。已有方法靠语义对齐或分词器-扩散联合训练来提升可扩散性，但成本高、机制不清。作者复查 REPA-E 发现：去掉其扩散目标和专用生成模块、仅保留从损坏潜变量做语义预测，在同等设置下即可达到相当的下游生成性能，说明关键在于"从损坏潜变量预测"这一鲁棒性，而非扩散目标本身。

Method: 基于"鲁棒预测"原则实例化两个互补目标：(1) RobustAlign——从损坏潜变量预测预训练语义特征，保留高层结构信息；(2) RobustRecon——从损坏潜变量重建干净图像，保留细粒度空间与外观信息。二者组合构成 RoAR-VAE。作者还给出分析：鲁棒预测使有用信息更多落入高方差潜变量方向，而扩散模型倾向于优先学习这些方向，从而提升可扩散性。

Result: 在相同训练预算下，RoAR-VAE 在生成基准上的平均性能比最强基线分词器高 2.19 分；小文本重建准确率比 FLUX.1-VAE 高 16.93 个百分点。

Conclusion: 鲁棒预测是提升潜变量可扩散性的有效而简洁的原则，不依赖扩散目标或专用生成模块。RoAR-VAE 在重建保真度与下游生成可学习性之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: An effective visual tokenizer must preserve image fidelity while producing latents that downstream diffusion models can learn efficiently. Prior work improves latent diffusability through semantic alignment or joint tokenizer--diffusion training. Revisiting REPA-E, a representative approach, we find that removing its diffusion objective and dedicated generative blocks while retaining semantic prediction from corrupted latents yields comparable downstream generation performance under a matched setting. This observation motivates a general principle of robust prediction: generation-relevant information should remain recoverable from corrupted latents. We instantiate this principle with two complementary objectives. RobustAlign predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents to preserve high-level structure, while RobustRecon reconstructs the clean image to retain fine-grained spatial and appearance information. Together, they form Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE). Our analysis suggests that robust prediction improves diffusability by making useful information more accessible in high-variance latent directions, which diffusion models tend to learn earlier. Empirically, RoAR-VAE improves average generation benchmark performance by 2.19 points over the strongest baseline tokenizer under the same training budget, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy by 16.93 percentage points over FLUX.1-VAE. These results demonstrate that RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and downstream generative learnability.

</details>


### [240] [SAR2Net: Learning Spatially Anchored Representations for Retrieval-Guided Cross-Stain Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26217)
*Tianle Shen,Fang Yan,Xiaofan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SAR2Net框架，将跨染色全切片图像（WSI）对齐重构为区域级特征检索问题，通过学习编码组织拓扑相对空间关系的不变表示实现稳健对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 整合形态学与分子信息需要跨染色WSI的空间对齐，但WSI分辨率极高、存在组织碎片化与大幅非线性形变，传统依赖全局预对齐和空间一致性的配准流程在此类畸变下往往失效。

Method: SAR2Net不估计显式变换，而是学习逐点空间锚定表示：给定组织标志点与任意坐标，预测相对标志点的空间关系特征，作为形变不变的组织拓扑描述子；随后采用两阶段检索框架在切片间建立对应关系，即使全局对齐不可行亦可工作。

Result: 在面向活检的HE-IHC数据集上，SAR2Net在严重组织畸变下实现稳健的区域级对齐，优于此前方法；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 以形变不变的空间锚定特征检索替代传统全局配准，可有效应对WSI跨染色对齐中的碎片化与强非线性形变问题，为多模态病理整合提供可行途径。

Abstract: Achieving spatial alignment between whole-slide images(WSIs) across stains is essential for integrating morphology and molecular information, yet it remains challenging due to extreme resolution, tissue fragmentation, and large nonlinear deformations. Conventional registration pipelines depend on global pre-alignment and spatial consistency, which often collapse under such distortions. We present SAR2Net, a framework that learns spatially anchored representations and reformulates cross-stain alignment as a region-level feature retrieval problem. Instead of estimating explicit transformations, SAR2Net learns pointwise representations encoding the relative spatial relationships to tissue landmarks. Given landmarks and arbitrary coordinates, it predicts spatially anchored features that serve as deformation-invariant descriptors of tissue topology. A twostage retrieval framework then establishes correspondences between slides, even when global alignment is infeasible. Experiments on biopsy-oriented HE-IHC datasets show that SAR2Net achieves robust region-level alignment under severe tissue distortions, outperforming previous methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Shentl/SAR2Net.

</details>


### [241] [RECAP: Reciprocal Sparse Attention and Hierarchical Caching for Efficient Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26244)
*Tiange Xu,Kai Liu,Linghe Kong,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RECAP：训练-free 方法，将稀疏注意力与分层缓存通过"互惠校正"耦合，并用在线误差反馈自适应协调，实现视频扩散 Transformer 的高保真加速（HunyuanVideo 720p 上 3.05x 加速）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 生成视频质量高但计算昂贵。稀疏注意力（减少去噪步内计算）与时间缓存（减少跨步计算）天然可组合，但直接组合会产生问题：用稀疏注意力得到的预测会被作为时间复用的源，其误差沿采样轨迹耦合累积。作者观察到两点：提升这些源的精度可在不改变复用调度的情况下恢复保真度；且邻近步的稀疏化误差在方向上保持一致，说明校正信息可被共享而非重复计算。

Method: 提出 RECAP，一种无需训练的方法，通过互惠校正（reciprocal correction）耦合稀疏注意力与分层缓存，并由在线误差反馈自适应协调。具体机制包括：(1) 缓存式稠密精化（cached dense refinement）校正当前稀疏估计中被省略的交互；(2) 新鲜的稀疏统计量跟踪输入变化并调节"老化"校正的强度；(3) 校正后的预测用于更新整步预测复用的源，使预测历史可在两次稠密刷新之间推进。

Result: 在多个视频扩散模型上，与稀疏注意力方法、缓存方法及其直接组合进行对比。在 HunyuanVideo 上生成 720p、5 秒视频时，RECAP 实现 3.05x 加速，并在保真度和推理速度上均优于所有测试的直接组合方案。

Conclusion: 稀疏注意力和时间缓存的简单叠加会因误差耦合而损失保真度；通过共享误差校正信息、以误差反馈动态协调两者的交互，可在不训练的前提下同时获得显著加速与更优生成质量。

Abstract: Diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos but remain computationally expensive. Sparse attention and temporal caching reduce computation within and across denoising steps, respectively, offering a natural composition. However, predictions produced with sparse attention become sources for temporal reuse, coupling their errors along the sampling trajectory. We observe that improving the accuracy of these sources recovers fidelity without changing the reuse schedule, and that sparsification errors remain directionally aligned across nearby steps, suggesting that correction information can be shared rather than recomputed. These observations motivate RECAP, a training-free method that couples sparse attention with hierarchical caching through reciprocal correction, adaptively coordinated by online error feedback. Cached dense refinement corrects omitted interactions in current sparse estimates, while fresh sparse statistics track input changes and regulate the aging correction. The resulting predictions then renew the sources for whole-step prediction reuse, allowing prediction history to advance between dense refreshes. We evaluate RECAP on multiple video diffusion models against sparse-attention methods, caching methods, and their direct compositions. On HunyuanVideo at 720p 5-second generation, RECAP achieves a 3.05x speedup and outperforms all tested direct compositions in both fidelity and inference speed.

</details>


### [242] [XGLASS: X-Ray, Gaze and Language Assisted Slice Sequencing for CT Volumes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26255)
*Michael Glöckler,Timo Ropinski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: XGLASS 将 2D X 光上的放射科医生注视先验迁移到 3D CT，实现任务感知的轴位切片优先级排序，用极少切片即可覆盖诊断相关切片并在下游分类中显著省算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D 视觉语言模型受限于 3D 训练数据稀缺与 2D 基础架构主导，性能落后；而直接借用强大的 2D VLM 分析含数百层切片的 CT/MRI 体积又不可行，因此必须先聚焦少数具诊断价值的切片。

Method: 提出 XGLASS：由 X 光上与语言对齐的放射科医生注视生成疾病条件的重要性图，将其与冠状位 CT 投影进行空间对齐，使注视先验与 CT 内容进入共享 2D 表示；再用融合表示预测疾病特异的轴位切片排序，优先挑选诊断相关切片。作为轻量预选器使用。

Result: 预算受限检索显著优于 2D 与 3D 原生基线，最佳疾病 top-10 命中率达 75.9%（仅看 240 层中的前 10 层，即 4.17%）；下游切片级发现分类中，30 层候选集将模型调用减少 87.5%，F1 较全切片推理提升 11.3 个百分点、较最强 2D 选择器提升 4.2 点，与 3D 原生选择器相当，但每发现所需时间少至 130.8 倍、GPU 显存少 10.9 倍。

Conclusion: XGLASS 可作为体数据 CT 分析的轻量级预选器，把 2D 医学视觉语言能力有效迁移到 3D，兼顾检索效果与计算效率；代码与预训练权重已开源。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve remarkable performance on 2D medical images, such as X-rays or pathology images, while 3D VLMs that directly process CT/MRI volumes lag behind due to limited 3D training data and the predominance of 2D foundation architectures. To leverage powerful 2D VLMs for analyzing medical volumes, which contain hundreds of slices, it is therefore necessary to focus only on those few slices, which are diagnostically relevant. To enable such a prioritization, we propose XGLASS, a method that transfers medical expertise from 2D X-rays to 3D CT for task-aware slice prioritization. XGLASS uses disease-conditioned importance maps derived from language-aligned radiologist gaze on X-rays and spatially aligns them with coronal CT projections, bringing gaze priors and CT content into a shared 2D representation. The fused gaze-prior/CT projection is then used to predict a disease-specific ordering of axial slices, prioritizing diagnostically relevant slices. XGLASS significantly improves budgeted retrieval over 2D and 3D-native baselines, achieving a top-10 hit rate up to 75.9% for the best-performing disease. In practice, this means that after inspecting only the top 10 slices (4.17% of a 240-slice scan), XGLASS identifies a diagnostically relevant slice in more than 75% of cases. For downstream slice-wise finding classification, an XGLASS-selected 30-slice candidate set reduces model calls by 87.5% while improving F1 by 11.3 percentage points over all-slice inference, 4.2 points over the strongest 2D selector, and remains competitive with 3D-native selectors while requiring up to 130.8 times less time and 10.9 times less GPU memory per finding, supporting its use as a lightweight preselector for volumetric CT analysis. The code and pretrained checkpoint are available on https://github.com/michaelgloeckler/XGLASS.

</details>


### [243] [Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26262)
*Yuanyu He,Zhuokun Chen,Yefei He,Zhiwei Tang,Jiasheng Tang,Yinghao Yu,Jianfei Cai,Bohan Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention（DASA）统一框架，将自回归扩散 Transformer 长视频生成由稠密计算转为稀疏、运动驱动的生成，同时消除存储与计算冗余，在 VBench 上实现 2.16 倍加速并保持高视觉保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归扩散 Transformer 已成为长视频生成的有效范式，但计算开销与显存占用过高。其低效源于稠密计算机制对所有时空区域分配统一处理资源，未利用视频固有的时间冗余性——运动通常仅局限于稀疏区域。

Method: 受视频编解码原理启发，显式将视频内容解耦为动态区域与静态区域。内存方面，选择性压缩历史 KV cache，仅保留已生成 chunk 内的动态特征；计算方面，基于局部动态性采用区域级计算分配策略；并引入动态引导的蒸馏方法，通过轻量蒸馏训练流程提升性能。

Result: 在 VBench 上，方法将自回归视频生成加速 2.16 倍，同时保持较高的视觉保真度。

Conclusion: DASA 通过动态感知的稀疏注意力与 KV cache 压缩，有效缓解了自回归扩散 Transformer 在长视频生成中的计算与存储瓶颈，验证了运动驱动的稀疏化路线在效率与质量间的良好平衡。

Abstract: Autoregressive Diffusion Transformers have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, they are often constrained by prohibitive computational overhead and substantial memory footprints. This inefficiency arises from dense computation mechanisms that allocate uniform processing resources across all spatiotemporal regions, failing to leverage the inherent temporal redundancy of video where motion is typically confined to sparse areas. In this paper, we propose Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention (DASA), a unified framework that shifts from dense computation to sparse, motion-driven generation to eliminate both storage and computational redundancies. Inspired by video codec principles, our approach explicitly decouples video content into dynamic and static regions. To mitigate memory bottlenecks, we selectively compress the historical KV cache by retaining only dynamic features within the generated chunk. Furthermore, to reduce computational overhead, we employ a region-level computation allocation strategy based on localized dynamics. Additionally, a dynamics-guided distillation method is introduced to enhance performance via a lightweight distillation training process. Experiments on VBench demonstrate that our approach accelerates autoregressive video generation by 2.16x, while preserving high visual fidelity.

</details>


### [244] [TIM: Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26271)
*Yiheng Dong,Yi Lin,Shilong Huang,Xiyan Yang,Xin Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两阶段框架TIM，通过"时间解耦表示学习"与"迭代互细化"实现纵向放射报告生成（LRRG），在Longitudinal-MIMIC上取得语言与临床指标的新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动放射报告生成多聚焦单时间点分析，难以刻画疾病跨纵向检查的时序演变；已有的纵向RRG方法虽引入历史数据，但把不同时间点图像混在同一表示空间中，导致语义模糊、时序推理不一致。

Method: TIM为两阶段框架。Stage I 做时间解耦表示学习，将时序演变模式与疾病特异性（空间病理）特征分离，并分别为先前检查与当前检查生成报告；Stage II 引入互报告细化机制，识别先前报告中的诊断不一致，基于错误敏感反馈迭代修正先前与当前两份报告。

Result: 在Longitudinal-MIMIC数据集上，TIM优于现有单图与纵向基线，在语言指标与临床指标上均达到新的SOTA；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 显式解耦空间病理与时序进展、并以互反馈迭代细化报告，是提升纵向放射报告生成质量的有效范式。

Abstract: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to translate medical images into diagnostic text, reducing radiologists' workload and standardizing clinical documentation. Nonetheless, existing approaches mainly focus on single-timepoint analysis and fail to capture temporal disease evolution across longitudinal examinations. While recent longitudinal RRG (LRRG) approaches incorporate historical data, they often combine images from different time points within a single representation space, leading to blurred semantics and inconsistent temporal reasoning. In this work, we propose a Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model (TIM), a two-stage framework that explicitly decouples spatial pathology from temporal progression and iteratively refines reports through mutual feedback. Stage I performs temporal-decoupled representation learning, separating temporal evolution patterns from disease-specific features and generating radiology reports for both prior and current studies. Stage II introduces a mutual report refinement mechanism that identifies diagnostic inconsistencies within prior reports and iteratively rectifies both prior and current reports through error-sensitive feedback. Experiments on the Longitudinal-MIMIC dataset demonstrate that TIM surpasses existing single-image and longitudinal baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance across both language and clinical metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/yihengd/TIM.

</details>


### [245] [From Cause to Effect: Generating Intermediate Event Chains in Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26275)
*Ridouane Ghermi,Vicky Kalogeiton,Ivan Laptev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出因果链生成（CCG）任务：要求模型生成连接原因与结果的中间事件序列，并配套两个自动评测指标（SODA-Embedding 与 Causal-QA）以及两个测试集，用以更可靠地评测视频-语言模型的因果推理能力，并用复合奖励的 GRPO 微调显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频-语言模型在视觉识别上表现优异，但因果推理能力薄弱；而当前评测方式存在缺陷：多项选择问答容易被捷径利用，开放式问答又缺乏稳健的自动评测手段。因此需要一个既要求真实推理、又能可靠自动打分的评测设置。

Method: 提出因果链生成任务，要求模型生成原因与结果之间的中间事件序列。设计两个互补指标：SODA-Embedding 衡量生成链与参考链的语义匹配；Causal-QA 通过提问链中是否包含重构叙事所需的特定因果事实来检验其因果连贯性。构建两个测试集：SF20K-CC（20 部短片上人工标注的诊断集）与 CMD-CC（基于音频描述构建的电影片段基准）。并以格式奖励、SODA-Embedding 与 Causal-QA 准确率组成的复合奖励，用 GRPO 微调视频-语言模型。

Result: 分析显示当前最先进的视频-语言模型在叙事因果理解上存在明显困难，经常幻觉或遗漏关键事件；采用复合奖励的 GRPO 微调后，模型相较强基线取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 结构化的因果链生成任务能够同时满足"要求真实推理"与"支持可靠自动评测"两点需求，可作为评测和改进视频-语言模型叙事因果理解的有效框架。

Abstract: Video-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual recognition but struggle with causal reasoning. Current evaluations are flawed: multiple-choice QA allows shortcuts, and open-ended QA lacks robust automatic evaluation. We introduce Causal Chain Generation (CCG), a novel task where models have to generate the sequence of intermediate events connecting a cause and an effect. This structured setup demands genuine reasoning and enables reliable automatic scoring. We accompany this task with two complementary metrics: SODA-Embedding, which measures the semantic matching of a generated chain against a reference, and Causal-QA, which probes the chain's causal coherence by asking whether it contains the specific causal facts needed to reconstruct the narrative. We provide two test sets: SF20K-CC, a manually annotated diagnostic on 20 short films, and CMD-CC, a movie clip benchmark derived from audio descriptions. Our analysis reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with narrative causality understanding, frequently hallucinating or omitting key events. To address this, we fine-tune VLMs with GRPO using a composite reward that combines a format reward, SODA-Embedding, and Causal-QA accuracy, demonstrating substantial improvements over strong baselines.

</details>


### [246] [CARNet: End-to-End Coupled Association-Recognition Network for Fine-Grained Multi-Drone Collaborative Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26312)
*Zhao Zhang,Ruigang Fu,Yu Zhang,Jiajun Xiang,Zixuan Xiao,Ping Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出耦合关联-识别网络CARNet，将跨视角目标关联与融合识别统一到共享的目标对表示中联合优化，并构建细粒度多无人机协同车辆检测基准MDMT-CD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多无人机协同检测采用"先建立跨视角对应、再做融合识别"的两阶段流程，存在优化目标不一致、成对建模冗余、误差不可逆传播等问题，错误关联会直接损害后续识别性能。

Method: 提出统一框架CARNet，通过共享的目标对表示联合优化跨视角关联与识别融合；在密集且外观相似场景中显式引入空间线索增强成对关系建模；引入两种因果启发的干预策略，其一通过强调外观易混淆目标对提升关联可靠性，其二通过在不完整视觉证据下学习稳定多视角表示增强识别鲁棒性；同时构建MDMT-CD数据集，为原始车辆标注补充细粒度类别标签。

Result: 大量实验表明CARNet持续优于现有最先进方法；MDMT-CD成为首个面向多无人机协同车辆检测的细粒度基准。

Conclusion: 通过联合优化关联与识别、引入空间线索与因果干预策略，可有效缓解两阶段范式的误差传播问题，提升多无人机协同检测的精度与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Multi-drone collaborative detection aims to enhance target recognition by leveraging complementary observations from overlapping aerial viewpoints. Existing approaches typically follow a two-stage pipeline that first establishes cross-view correspondences and then performs fusion-based recognition. However, this decomposition suffers from inconsistent optimization objectives, redundant pairwise modeling, and irreversible error propagation, where incorrect associations inevitably undermine subsequent recognition performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Coupled Association-Recognition Network (CARNet), a unified framework that jointly optimizes cross-view target association and recognition fusion through a shared target-pair representation. To improve association reliability in densely populated scenes with visually similar targets, CARNet explicitly incorporates spatial cues into pairwise relation modeling. Moreover, we introduce two complementary causal-inspired intervention strategies: the first enhances cross-view association by emphasizing appearance-confusing pairs, while the second bolsters the robustness of fusion-based recognition by learning stable multi-view representations under incomplete visual evidence. In addition, we present MDMT-CD, a fine-grained extension of the MDMT dataset that enriches the original vehicle annotations with detailed category labels, providing the first benchmark specifically designed for multi-drone collaborative vehicle detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CARNet consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. The MDMT-CD dataset and source code will be available at https://github.com/bigdreaming11/CARNet.

</details>


### [247] [MCDA: Multi-View Graph Contrastive Learning with Dynamic Topology Augmentation for Functional MRI Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26322)
*Hao Zhang,Xiaoyun Liu,Shuo Huang,Yue Ma,Liang Cao,Mingxia Liu,Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出拓扑引导的多视图图对比学习框架 MCDA，引入动态增强更新模块迭代细化增强拓扑，结合自感知与跨样本增强策略，并在多视图间做拓扑引导对比学习，用于 rs-fMRI 脑疾病诊断，在 1236 名受试者的两个公开数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图对比学习（GCL）方法在 rs-fMRI 分析中未能充分利用跨训练轮次的增强历史，也未挖掘不同增强视图之间的关系，限制了结构信息的保留与判别性表征的学习。

Method: 1) 动态增强更新（DAU）模块，替代固定噪声或丢边，逐轮迭代精化增强拓扑；2) 自感知与跨样本增强策略，同时捕获个体特有的功能特征与受试者间异质性；3) 拓扑引导多视图图对比学习方案，既探索原始网络与其增强视图之间的关系，也探索不同增强视图之间的关系；4) 刻画得分级优化方向并推导对比目标的下界；5) 联合分类损失与对比损失进行诊断，并分析判别性功能连接模式作为潜在生物标志物。

Result: 在两个公开 rs-fMRI 数据集共 1236 名受试者上的实验表明，MCDA 优于当前最先进方法；并识别出具有判别性的功能连接模式作为潜在生物标志物，代码已公开。

Conclusion: 动态拓扑增强与拓扑引导的多视图对比学习能更充分地利用增强历史与视图间关系，提升脑疾病诊断性能，并具备一定的可解释性生物学发现价值。

Abstract: Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) is a vital non-invasive tool for diagnosing brain disorders and uncovering pathological mechanisms. However, existing graph contrastive learning (GCL) methods often underexploit augmentation histories across training epochs and the relationships among different augmented views. In this paper, we introduce a topology-guided Multi-view graph Contrastive learning framework with Dynamic graph topology Augmentation (MCDA) for fMRI analysis. Unlike traditional GCL that uses fixed noise or edge-dropping, MCDA employs a Dynamic Augmentation Update (DAU) module that iteratively refines the augmented topology. Specifically, we incorporate self-aware and cross-sample augmentation strategies to simultaneously capture individual-specific functional signatures and inter-subject heterogeneity. We then design a topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning scheme that explores interrelationships not only between the original network and its augmented views, but also across different augmented views to maximize structural information preservation. We characterize the score-level optimization directions and establish a lower bound for the contrastive objective. The framework combines classification and contrastive losses for brain disorder diagnosis and examines discriminative functional connectivity patterns as potential biomarkers. Experiments on two public rs-fMRI datasets comprising 1,236 subjects demonstrate that MCDA outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. The code has been made publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/goodcodingagoodboy/MCDA}.

</details>


### [248] [TriScore: Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection with Energy, Boundary Probes, and Transform Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26323)
*Ege Gursoy,Nicolas Mansard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TriScore：融合能量先验、边界脆弱性、变换一致性三个ID校准信号的post-hoc OOD检测器，在分类器级对抗偏移下更稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有post-hoc OOD检测多依赖从冻结分类器中提取的单一信号（置信度、能量、特征、梯度），在分类器级对抗偏移下易失效——偏移可在保留检测线索的同时改变模型决策行为。

Method: 研究是否可用互补准则组合替代单一分数。TriScore在同一冻结主干上融合三个经ID验证数据标准化的信号：能量先验、边界脆弱性分数、变换一致性分数，并由输入相关的ID残差门控融合；无需OOD标签、辅助模型、训练或特征库存储。

Result: 在四个ImageNet规模主干上，非自适应对抗偏移协议下，TriScore在15个post-hoc基线中平均AUROC最优，同时在标准OOD基准上保持竞争力；消融显示增益来自互补线索融合而非单一信号优化。

Conclusion: 多准则post-hoc检测是提升分类器级偏移下OOD检测稳健性的可行途径，代码已公开。

Abstract: Post-hoc out-of-distribution detection usually relies on a single signal extracted from a frozen classifier, such as confidence, energy, features, or gradients. This dependence becomes fragile under classifier-level adversarial shift, where the shift can preserve the detector's chosen cue while changing the model's decision behavior. We investigate whether this failure mode can be mitigated by combining complementary detection criteria instead of selecting a single score. We introduce TriScore, a post-hoc OOD detector that combines three ID-calibrated signals from the same frozen backbone: an energy prior, a boundary-fragility score, and a transform-consistency score. These signals are standardized on ID validation data and fused by an input-dependent ID-residual gate, requiring no OOD labels, auxiliary model, training, or stored feature bank. Across four ImageNet-scale backbones, TriScore achieves the best mean AUROC among 15 post-hoc baselines under a non-adaptive adversarial-shift protocol, while remaining competitive on standard OOD benchmarks. Ablations show that the gains come from combining complementary cues rather than optimizing a single detector signal. These results support multi-criterion post-hoc detection as a practical route toward more robust OOD detection under classifier-level shift. The source code is publicly available at github.com/gursoyege/TriScore.

</details>


### [249] [HGASurv: Hierarchical Granularity-Aware Integration for Multimodal Survival Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26357)
*Peike Yu,Wuchao Liu,Jihong Guan,Shuigeng Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HGASurv框架，用层次化WSI编码与临床引导图传播实现粒度感知的多模态生存预测，在三个TCGA队列上取得最佳C-index。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态生存预测方法未能充分处理模态间的粒度差异，尤其是空间组织方式和特征维度上的不一致。

Method: 层次化WSI编码模块按原始坐标将patch特征映射到空间网格，用并行卷积构建patch、局部邻域、区域三个尺度的表示；基因组signature嵌入通过跨模态co-attention查询各尺度WSI表示，得到signature条件下的形态特征；临床引导图传播模块以临床变量定义患者相似性边，用图注意力传播融合后的图像-基因组节点嵌入，通过拓扑而非特征拼接整合临床信息。

Result: 在三个TCGA队列上整体C-index表现最佳；消融实验支持两个模块的互补贡献。

Conclusion: 通过层次化WSI编码与临床引导图传播，将多尺度病理表示与基于拓扑的临床整合统一为粒度感知框架，表明表示与整合机制同模态特异性粒度相匹配可提升多模态生存预测性能。

Abstract: Objective: Multimodal survival prediction jointly analyzes histopathological whole-slide images (WSIs), genomic profiles, and clinical variables to stratify patients by risk. However, existing approaches often inadequately account for granularity differences across modalities, particularly in spatial organization and feature dimensionality. To address these challenges, we propose HGASurv, which introduces a hierarchical WSI encoding module and a clinical-guided graph propagation module for granularity-aware multimodal integration. Methods: The hierarchical WSI encoding module maps WSI patch features onto a spatial grid using their original coordinates and applies parallel convolutions to construct representations at patch, local-neighborhood, and regional scales. Genomic signature embeddings then query these scale-specific WSI representations through cross-modal co-attention, producing signature-conditioned morphological features. The clinical-guided graph propagation module uses clinical variables to define patient-similarity edges and propagates fused image-genomic node embeddings with graph attention, integrating clinical information through topology rather than feature concatenation. Results: Across three TCGA cohorts, HGASurv achieved the strongest overall C-index performance, with ablation studies supporting the complementary contributions of the hierarchical WSI encoding and clinical-guided graph propagation modules. Conclusion and Significance: By introducing hierarchical WSI encoding and clinical-guided graph propagation, HGASurv unifies multi-scale pathology representation with topology-based clinical integration in a hierarchical granularity-aware framework. This design shows that matching representation and integration mechanisms to modality-specific granularity improves multimodal survival prediction.

</details>


### [250] [From Legacy to Contemporary: Scalable Color Modernization for Long Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26391)
*Dongyun Kim,Jiwoo Choi,Jaeseong Lee,Seon Joo Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"长视频色彩现代化"任务，并给出一种免训练、可扩展的框架：用预训练文本引导图像编辑模型对时间相邻关键帧网格联合现代化，再用镜头级紧凑色彩变换把调整传播到整段镜头，实现跨帧跨镜头一致的复古影像现代化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 老视频上屏后仍显陈旧：早期成像流程留下偏色、饱和度低、对比弱、色调失衡等问题；人工调色师校正成本高，难以扩展到长时长、多镜头的视频。现有方法也缺少对长视频跨镜头一致性和系统评测的支撑。

Method: 1) 任务定义为在保持场景内容与跨帧/跨镜头连贯性的前提下，更新老素材的色彩与影调外观；2) 无需配对监督的训练免费框架：将时间相邻的关键帧组织成网格，联合输入预训练的文本引导图像编辑模型，得到连贯的现代感参考帧；3) 为每个镜头拟合紧凑的色彩变换，将调整传播至整镜头所有帧，保持空间结构与时间稳定性。

Result: 在跨越五十年的多样老视频上做多维评测：结合"现代感"人工主观评价，以及内容保真、时间稳定性、感知质量和效率等定量指标，并提出 SW-IGC（Source-Weighted Inter-shot Grade Consistency）衡量跨镜头调色一致性。结果显示该方法感知现代感最高，且在其他互补指标上具竞争力。

Conclusion: 该工作为长视频色彩现代化提供了可扩展、无需配对数据的解决路径与系统评测协议，为后续系统化研究奠定基础，代码已开源。

Abstract: Bringing legacy video back to contemporary screens does not necessarily make it look contemporary. Earlier imaging pipelines often leave color casts, muted chroma, weak con- trast, and tonal imbalance, while correcting these character- istics still relies heavily on expert colorists and scales poorly to long, multi-shot videos. We formulate long video color modernization, a task that updates the chromatic and tonal appearance of legacy color footage while preserving scene content and coherence across frames and shots. We introduce a scalable, training-free framework that jointly modernizes grids of temporally adjacent keyframes using a pretrained text-guided image editing model, producing coherent con- temporary references without paired supervision. Compact shot-specific color transforms then propagate these adjust- ments throughout each shot, preserving spatial structure and temporal stability. We conduct a multidimensional evaluation on diverse legacy videos spanning five decades. We combine a human evaluation of perceived modernness with quantita- tive measures of content fidelity, temporal stability, percep- tual quality, and efficiency, and introduce Source-Weighted Inter-shot Grade Consistency (SW-IGC) to assess grade co- herence across shots. On our evaluation set, our frame- work achieves the highest perceived modernness while re- maining competitive across complementary measures, open- ing a path toward the systematic study of long video color modernization. Code is available at https://github.com/jiwoomood/ Video_Color_Modernization.git

</details>


### [251] [One Fact, Many Places: Redundant Evidence in Long Visual Documents Breaks Single-Gold Evaluation of Retrieval, Citation and Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26401)
*Xiaokang Yuan,Binhui Yao,Luwei Yang,Ruimin Chen,Zeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出长文档理解评测中"事实只存在于唯一位置"的单一金标准假设不成立：事实常在多处（含跨模态）重复出现，导致检索召回、引用评判和归因定位三类评测系统性失真，并提出冗余感知的评测指标与集合级掩码方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档理解评测以标注的单一金标准位置为基准打分，默认每个事实只存在于一处。但在长视觉文档中，同一个事实常以副本形式出现在图表、正文、摘要等多个位置，这种重复会使检索命中被判为未命中、正确引用被判为错误引用、掩码实验高估模型对证据的依赖，从而扭曲基准排名与结论。

Method: 作者从 MMLongBench-Doc 与 MMDocRAG 中选取 420 个问题，由两名独立评审标注每个所需事实的所有可独立确立位置；据此统计副本（含跨模态、跨页副本）的出现频率，并量化单一金标准打分在三方面的偏差：检索召回被低估、引用等价性导致成对排序反转、金标准区域掩码后答案仍存活。随后提出集合级掩码与冗余感知指标，并与未经验证的关键字符串规则基线对比。

Result: 副本普遍存在：19.5% 的 MMLongBench-Doc 测试问题在金标准之外有严格副本；28% 的 MMDocRAG 问题中仅非金标准候选就足以提供所需事实。在有跨页副本的问题上，文本与视觉检索器的 page recall@1 被低估 13–24 个百分点；承认等价证据会改变 65 个竞品 MMDocRAG 系统中 11% 的成对排序。掩码金标准区域时，含副本输入下四个模型有 41–56% 的正确答案存活，而掩码全部标注实例后则失败。用自动发现的副本做集合级掩码，可在匹配粒度下弥合至全标注掩码差距的 78%（三个模型）；未验证的字符串规则效果相近但掩码面积达三倍。

Conclusion: 单一金标准的位置评测在存在冗余证据的基准上系统性低估检索与归因能力并扭曲系统排序，掩码式归因实验亦会高估证据依赖性。作者发布标注数据与冗余感知指标，主张评测从"答案来自哪里"转向"所有可独立确立该事实的位置"，并为集合级掩码提供低成本近似方案。

Abstract: Document understanding is increasingly judged on where an answer comes from, scored against annotated gold locations as if each fact lived in one place. In long visual documents, a fact often lives in several places: a chart value is restated in the text, a key figure reappears in the summary. We ask how often such copies occur in standard benchmarks and what they do to evaluation. We annotate 420 questions from MMLongBench-Doc and MMDocRAG with the locations that independently establish each required fact, checked by two independent reviewers. Copies are common and often cross-modal: 19.5% of MMLongBench-Doc test questions have a strict copy outside the gold, and in 28% of MMDocRAG questions a non-gold candidate alone supplies a required fact. Single-gold scoring then fails in three predictable ways. A retriever that finds a copy is scored as a miss: page recall@1 of text and visual retrievers is underestimated by 13-24 points on questions with a cross-page copy. A model that cites a copy is scored as citing wrongly: crediting equivalent evidence reverses 11% of pairwise orderings among 65 competitive MMDocRAG systems. Masking the gold region leaves the fact available elsewhere: with a copy in the input, 41-56% of correct answers across four models survive it yet fail once every annotated instance is masked. Set-level masking with automatically found copies closes 78% of the gap to masking every annotated instance at matched granularity (three models); an unverified key-string rule lowers survival at least as far but masks three times the area. We release the annotations and redundancy-aware metrics.

</details>


### [252] [Policy-Adaptive Credit Assignment for Spatial Reasoning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26410)
*Hailiang Yang,Shengchao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出CALIPER自适应过程奖励框架与SpatialTrace数据语料：用组内岭回归估计各阶段参考覆盖率与答案正确性的关联，作为效用代理逐步更新奖励权重，并对齐所有rollout组（含全部失败组）；配合闭环监控可靠性以指导回滚、rollout多样化与早停。在8个基准、3个骨干上取得最高均值，优于固定权重分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像空间推理需要感知、分解、推理等多阶段能力，而限制准确率的关键阶段在训练过程中会发生变化。答案级奖励无法定位失败到具体阶段，且当组内所有rollout奖励相同时缺乏组相对区分性反馈；过程监督虽有中间反馈，但固定权重无法随瓶颈变化自适应分配奖励。

Method: 提出CALIPER自适应过程奖励框架，并构建阶段分解的空间推理轨迹语料SpatialTrace。方法通过组内岭回归联合估计各阶段参考覆盖率与答案正确性之间的关联，以该关联作为效用代理，逐步更新各阶段奖励权重，从而对所有rollout组（包括全部失败的组）提供过程奖励监督。由于答案可区分组稀少时效用估计可能不可靠，引入闭环harness监控估计器可靠性与验证性能，用于指导checkpoint回滚、rollout多样化和早停。

Result: 在8个基准与3个骨干网络上进行实验，CALIPER在one-shot与harness训练两种设置下均取得最高平均性能，并在不同RL优化器上一致优于固定奖励分配。进一步分析确认了自适应奖励分配与harness控制的有效性，且在模型规模与数据规模上呈现良好扩展性。

Conclusion: 阶段瓶颈随训练动态变化，固定过程奖励权重非最优；基于组内统计关联的自适应奖励重分配可提供更具区分性的过程监督，辅以可靠性闭环控制可提升稳定性与性能，并具备良好扩展性。

Abstract: Image-based spatial reasoning requires perception, decomposition, and inference, but the stage that limits accuracy can change during training. Answer-level rewards neither localize failures to individual stages nor provide discriminative group-relative feedback when all rollouts receive the same reward. Process supervision provides intermediate feedback, but fixed weights cannot adapt reward allocation to these changing bottlenecks. To address this gap, we propose CALIPER, an adaptive process-reward framework supported by SpatialTrace, a corpus of stage-decomposed spatial reasoning traces. CALIPER jointly estimates the associations between stage-wise reference coverage and answer correctness through within-group ridge regression, using these associations as utility proxies to gradually update reward weights. The resulting process reward supervises all rollout groups, including uniformly failing ones. Because utility estimates can become unreliable when answer-discriminative groups are scarce, a closed-loop harness monitors estimator reliability and validation performance to guide checkpoint rollback, rollout diversification, and early stopping. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks and three backbones show that CALIPER achieves the highest mean under both one-shot and harness training, with consistent gains over fixed allocation across RL optimizers. Further analyses confirm the benefits of adaptive reward allocation and harness control, with favorable scaling in model/data size.

</details>


### [253] [Long-form Video-to-Text Summarization using Recursive Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26431)
*Alessia Intini,Lorenzo Vaiani,Enrico Chen,Luca Cagliero*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个递归式视频语言摘要模型RVLSM，通过语义时序分解（STD）与自适应多模态工具调用（AMTC）两大模块，缓解长上下文性能退化、时序连续性丢失与事件描述语义贫乏等问题，在长视频转文本摘要任务上稳定优于零样本VideoLLM基线并接近SOTA微调模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VideoLLM在短视频理解基准上进展显著，但在长视频摘要上表现不佳，主要原因有三：长上下文提示导致性能退化、难以保持时序连续性、事件描述缺乏语义丰富的概念。现有方法难以同时解决这三点，因此需要一种新的长视频转文本摘要框架。

Method: 提出RVLSM：递归地将视频分解为语义连贯的片段，把片段级推理交给VideoLLM子模型与外部工具。包含两个组件：(1) 语义时序分解（STD）——采用场景感知的分块策略，依据语义边界动态划分视频，以保持时序连贯与连续；(2) 自适应多模态工具调用（AMTC）——通过路由机制按需调用动作识别、OCR、ASR、目标检测等辅助模块，提升摘要的语义丰富度。

Result: 在VideoXum与MixTyVSum两个基准上，RVLSM在多种模型设置与多个指标下均稳定优于零样本VideoLLM基线，并与视频转文本摘要的SOTA微调模型具有竞争力；此外，其摘要中的命名实体与真实摘要所检测实体的对齐程度优于基线及SOTA方法，验证了所生成事件描述的显著性。

Conclusion: RVLSM表明，递归分解加工具增强的推理范式能有效应对长视频摘要中的长上下文退化与时序建模难题，并显著提升事件描述的语义显著性与实体一致性，为长视频转文本摘要提供了一条无需大规模微调即可具备竞争力的技术路线。

Abstract: While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones. This is mainly due to performance degradation caused by long-context prompts, the inherent difficulty of preserving temporal continuity and a lack of semantically rich concepts in event descriptions. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the first recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM) designed for video processing and tailored to long-form video-to-text summarization. RVLSM recursively decomposes videos into semantically coherent segments and delegates chunk-level reasoning to VideoLLM sub-models and external tools. It employs (1) Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD), which preserves temporal coherence and continuity through a scene-aware chunking strategy that dynamically partitions videos according to semantic boundaries, and (2) Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC), which ensures semantic richness of the summary via a routing mechanism that selectively invokes auxiliary modules such as action recognition, optical character recognition, automatic speech recognition, and object detection. Experiments on the VideoXum and MixTyVSum benchmarks show that RVLSM consistently improves over zero-shot VideoLLM baselines across multiple model settings and performance metrics, and is competitive with a state-of-the-art fine-tuned model for video-to-text summarization. Importantly, the named entities in the RVLSM's summaries align more closely with those detected in the ground-truth summaries than those detected by baseline and state-of-the-art methods, confirming the saliency of the event descriptions it generates.

</details>


### [254] [When Guidance Becomes a Guard: Early Interception of Unsafe Inputs in Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26452)
*Yanchun Li,Yujin Wu,Gangkai Shen,Ming Yang,Li Zeng,Xianlong Wang,Hangtao Zhang,Shujuan Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CSTI方法，利用扩散模型早期条件去噪响应中条件/无条件激活对比的紧凑统计量做线性读出，实现生成前的安全提前拦截检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文生图扩散模型可能生成不安全内容，而现有输出过滤只能在合成完成后介入，成本高且滞后。作者希望探索模型自身的原生生成信号是否可用于提前检测不安全与对抗性输入。

Method: 发现无分类器引导（CFG）在条件响应中暴露强安全信号，可通过紧凑统计量与线性读出获取。据此提出条件语义轨迹拦截（CSTI）：在早期检查点聚合条件与无条件响应的激活对比，进行校准的风险检测；用典型概念样本与安全样本拟合概念专属检测器，无需攻击样本、无需中间图像解码、无需修改生成器。

Result: 在5个生成器、4个对抗攻击集合和2个通用NSFW数据集上，在5%固定FPR条件下，CSTI在6个基线中总体性能最优；被拦截路径的生成延迟降低超过60%。

Conclusion: 原生条件响应（尤其是CFG下的条件-无条件对比）能有效支撑早期安全拦截，CSTI在性能与效率上均有优势。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can produce unsafe content, while output filtering intervenes only after synthesis. We investigate whether native generation signals enable early detection of unsafe and adversarial inputs. We find that classifier-free guidance exposes strong safety signals in conditional responses, accessible through compact statistics and linear readouts. Based on this finding, we propose Conditional Semantic Trajectory Interception (CSTI), which aggregates activation contrasts between conditional and unconditional responses at early checkpoints for calibrated risk detection. CSTI fits concept-specific detectors using canonical concept and safe examples, without attack samples, intermediate image decoding, or generator modification. Across five generators, four adversarial attack collections, and two general NSFW datasets, CSTI achieves the strongest overall performance among six baselines at a matched 5% FPR. Early interception reduces generation latency by over 60% on intercepted paths. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of native conditional responses for early safety interception.

</details>


### [255] [YUTELA: A Scalable Edge Cloud AIoT System for Multi-Site Video Anomaly Detection with Scene Specific Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26468)
*Shanle Yao,Babak Rahimi Ardabili,Amir Kimiyaie,Hamed Tabkhi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: YUTELA是一个边缘—服务器—云AIoT系统，用Jetson Thor替代工作站做多站点长期视频异常检测，吞吐最高提升2.03倍，并在4个公共站点31路摄像头上连续运行170小时验证可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在Ancilia框架基础上，将原本基于工作站的现场处理替换为更实用的边缘设备，以实现长期、多站点、多摄像头的视频异常检测，并支持低成本、按摄像头定制化的模型自适应。

Method: 用NVIDIA Jetson Thor边缘设备替代工作站；重设计多摄像头流水线，采用摄像头批处理与重分配、共享内存、减少阶段间数据传输、任务融合以及TensorRT加速推理；每路摄像头维护独立异常模型，收集到足够近期伪正常数据后由中心GPU服务器重训练并将权重回传边缘。

Result: 八路摄像头下TensorRT将吞吐从14.17提升至29.94 FPS；优化边缘节点在9种负载设置中7种超过Ancilia工作站，极端密度下吞吐达2.03倍，但轻负载（4/8路流）时延更高。170小时、4站点、31路摄像头实测：运行负载由场景活动与输入帧率决定而非摄像头数量，各站点重训练频率相差约3倍；101次自动训练事件仅占用约6.6%单块GPU；平均端到端告警时延6.8–15.4秒。

Conclusion: YUTELA验证了基于边缘的多摄像头处理具有实用性，并能在异构站点间以低成本实现摄像头级别的模型自适应，单个全局训练节点即可支撑数十个站点。

Abstract: Building upon our previous Ancilia framework, this work presents \emph{YUTELA}, an edge--server--cloud AIoT system for long-term, multi-site video anomaly detection. YUTELA replaces workstation-based on-site processing with NVIDIA Jetson Thor edge devices and redesigns the multi-camera pipeline through camera batching and redistribution, shared memory, reduced inter-stage data transfer, task integration, and TensorRT-accelerated inference. It maintains a separate anomaly model per camera, retrained on a centralized GPU server once enough recent pseudo-normal data are collected, with updated weights returned to the edge. With eight cameras, TensorRT increases throughput from 14.17 to 29.94 FPS under normal density, and the optimized edge node exceeds the throughput of the workstation-based Ancilia system in seven of nine workload settings, reaching up to 2.03 times its throughput at extreme density. This gain comes at the cost of higher latency under lighter loads with four or eight streams. YUTELA was then operated continuously for 170 hours at four public sites using 31 existing CCTV cameras. The deployment shows that runtime load is driven by scene activity and input frame rate rather than by camera count, and that retraining frequency varies by about three times across sites. The 101 automatically triggered training events occupied only about 6.6\% of a single GPU, indicating that one global node can support adaptation for tens of sites. Mean end-to-end alert latency ranged from 6.8 to 15.4~s depending on site traffic and anomaly type. These results show that YUTELA enables practical multi-camera edge processing with low-cost, camera-specific adaptation across heterogeneous sites.

</details>


### [256] [3D Diffusion Models for Medical Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26475)
*Frank-Peter Schilling,Daniel Barco,Philipp Denzel,Marc Stadelmann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对面向医学图像的3D扩散模型进行对比综述，聚焦其性能、局限与未来展望。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式深度学习方法（VAE、GAN、扩散模型）在图像合成上成果显著，扩散模型在保真度和样本多样性上表现更优且训练动态更灵活。医学影像（CT、MRI、PET）中此类模型可用于数据增强、域迁移、图像重建、修复、伪影校正等，并可依据患者特征、报告、分割掩码或图像进行条件生成。但医学图像的三维体数据特性带来显著的内存、算力和训练数据需求，因此需要系统梳理3D扩散模型的研究现状。

Method: 综述性比较分析：系统整理并对比已开发的、面向医学图像的3D扩散模型，围绕当前性能、局限性进行归纳，并给出未来工作展望。

Result: 本文提供了一份3D扩散模型在医学图像领域的对比性综述，总结了其在各类临床应用场景中的表现，并梳理了三维体数据处理带来的内存、算力与数据方面的挑战。

Conclusion: 3D扩散模型在医学图像合成与处理中具有广泛且重要的应用前景，但受限于三维数据的高资源需求，仍需在效率、数据利用与实用性方面进一步改进；文章据此提出了未来研究方向。

Abstract: Generative deep learning methods such as Variational Autoencoders, Generative Adversarial Networks or Diffusion Models have achieved remarkable results in image synthesis. In particular, Diffusion Models have demonstrated superior image fidelity and sample diversity compared to other approaches on standard benchmarks, while also offering more flexible training dynamics as evidenced both in natural image domains and in medical applications. In medical imaging including Computed Tomography, Magnetic Resonance Imaging or Positron Emission Tomography, such models have various important use-cases including data augmentation, domain transfer, image reconstruction, inpainting, image augmentation and artifact correction.
